input_mode.description: Stage 1 input: reads (FASTQ/FASTA) or kmc (KMC databases).

kmc_dir.description: Directory containing KMC databases (--input_mode kmc). Default: --data_dir.

kmc_allow_mixed.description: kmc mode: warn instead of stopping when the databases were built with different -ci, -cx or counter sizes.

skip_accession_check.description: Allow packs whose recorded accession differs from their file name.

kmer_size.description: Odd k-mer length from 15 to 63. Required with --input_mode reads. With --input_mode kmc, read from the databases.
kmer_size.errorMessage: must be an odd number from 15 to 63. In kmc mode, the value can come from the KMC databases.

num_bins.description: Number of k-mer bins and Stage 2 output shards.

min_kmer_count.description: Discard k-mers observed fewer than this many times within an accession. Default: 2 in reads mode; in kmc mode, the databases' own -ci applies and a larger value is enforced as well.
min_kmer_count.errorMessage: must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.

threshold.description: Two-sided minor-allele-frequency filter expressed as an accession-count threshold.

keep_kmer_counts.description: n for presence/absence; y for raw per-accession counts.

encoding.description: text or bits; bit encoding is for presence/absence only.

delimiter.description: Text value delimiter: none, tab, or space.
delimiter.errorMessage: must be 'tab', 'space' or 'none'. 'bits' is now --encoding bits.

write_core_kmers.description: Write k-mers present in every accession to a separate file.

kmer_count_cpus.description: CPUs and worker threads per KMER_COUNT job.

kmer_count_memory.description: Scheduler memory request per KMER_COUNT and KMC_TO_PACK job.
kmer_count_memory.errorMessage: must be a memory value, e.g. 128.GB or '64 GB'.

kmer_count_budget_gb.description: Stage 1 accumulation budget, GB. 0 uses 70% of the task's memory limit.

kmer_count_time.description: Wall-clock limit per KMER_COUNT and KMC_TO_PACK job.
kmer_count_time.errorMessage: must be a time value, e.g. 5h, 30m or '1d 6h'.

matrix_merge_memory.errorMessage: must be a memory value, e.g. 128.GB or '64 GB'.

matrix_merge_time.errorMessage: must be a time value, e.g. 5h, 30m or '1d 6h'.

clusterOptions.description: Additional SLURM options passed to jobs.

queue_size.description: Maximum queued and running jobs submitted by SLURM.

max_retries.description: Extra attempts for a job that failed because it ran out of memory or time (slurm only). 0 disables retries.

max_cpus.description: Largest CPU request for one job. With local, also the most CPUs the run uses.

max_memory.description: Largest memory request for one job. With local, also the most memory the run uses.
max_memory.errorMessage: must be a memory value, e.g. 128.GB or '64 GB'.

max_time.description: Largest time limit for one job (slurm only).
max_time.errorMessage: must be a time value, e.g. 5h, 30m or '1d 6h'.

kmer_count_publish_mode.description: Publish Stage 1 packs using link, copy, or move.

matrix_publish_mode.description: Publish Stage 2 matrices using link, copy, or move.

cleanup.description: Remove the Nextflow work directory after successful completion.

compress_kbin_packs.description: Compress published .kbin files after both stages finish.

src_dir.description: Set by the pipeline. Do not set.

container_mount_dirs.description: Set by the pipeline. Do not set.

local_limit_cpus.description: Set by the pipeline. Do not set.

local_limit_memory.description: Set by the pipeline. Do not set.

kmc_detected_kmer_size.description: Set by the pipeline. Do not set.

kmc_detected_format.description: Set by the pipeline. Do not set.

kmc_kmer_size_from_db.description: Set by the pipeline. Do not set.

kmc_detect_error.description: Set by the pipeline. Do not set.

help.description: Show the help text and exit.
